about: EquipWorthy Secret Lair drop calendar. Edit this file on GitHub to add or correct drops; both apps read it from the main branch. Times are ISO 8601 in UTC (9 a.m. Pacific is 16:00Z in daylight time, 17:00Z in standard time). Links must start with https://.

drops.name: Secret Lair Countdown Kit: Marvel's History of Heroes
drops.notes: 30 cards with art from 30 Marvel artists, plus 2 new cards from Marvel: Darkhold Destiny. Limited quantity; on sale 9 a.m. Pacific.
